derivation: Counts and metric flags were recomputed from the report's 5,600 embedded slot records and equal the report's groups, totals, CSV and Markdown; no number was changed.
Removed: task IDs, per-slot records, usage tokens, seconds, server paths, run directories, hostnames, provider credentials and raw conversations.

Renamed: groups -> runs; arm -> harness; display -> recorded_name; report lifecycle keys -> outcome keys (infrastructure_failed -> failed_infrastructure, provider_billing_failed -> failed_billing, model_failure -> failed_model, unclassified_failed -> failed_unattributed, *_unknown -> unknown_*).
Added: unknown_unattributed = unknown minus attributed unknown, equal to the report's unclassified_unknown count in every run.
Collapsed: the eight new_native_messages_* stage provenance labels into new_native.
Label convention: model label Gemini 3.1 Pro for the recorded name Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview; recorded_name keeps the report display name verbatim.
Metric score = 100 x true / 100; unknown_or_pending is metric-specific and never derived from scored.
failure_reasons groups the 16 exact slot reason strings over failed slots into 9 buckets (mapping in the lane A evidence report); unknown_reasons copies the report's unknown attribution counts.
Settings distributions count slots per recorded value; slots without a recorded value are not_recorded_slots (null in JSON, empty in CSV), never 0.
CSV: one row per run; an empty cell means not recorded; a setting with several recorded values lists them joined by ';' in the same order as its slot counts.

outcomes.basis: recomputed from report-embedded slots; receipt checks on 5,182 of 5,182 recorded receipts (3,982 new native, 1,200 inherited SDK): file present, sha256 matched, identity, lifecycle state, reason and caps agree; 418 historical and offline-derived slots record no receipt
outcomes.statement: Recomputed from the report's 5,600 embedded slot records; the counts equal the report's group table, CSV and Markdown summary. Receipt check performed: all 5,182 slots that record a receipt (3,982 new native, 1,200 inherited SDK) have the file present with a matching sha256, and its task, harness, lifecycle state, reason and caps agree with the report; the 418 historical and offline-derived slots record no receipt.

metrics.statement: Recomputed from the per-slot metric flags embedded in the report, not re-scored; flags exist only for scored runs, a missing flag stays unknown, and 236 historical scored runs record only full replication.

provenance.statement: Recomputed from each slot's recorded provenance class in the report.

budget.basis: recomputed from report-embedded slots; caps equal the receipt budget limits for 5,182 of 5,182 recorded receipts and the LIMITS constant in 7 of 7 stage sources; 418 historical and offline-derived slots not recorded
budget.statement: Recorded logical caps copied from report slots for new and inherited SDK runs; they equal the caps in all 5,182 receipts and the harness source configuration; not independent execution measurements; none recorded for historical or offline-derived runs.

thinking.basis: no-override checked in the frozen plan (14 of 14 routes) and harness code (7 of 7 stage sources); Claude CLI behaviour is a handoff and daily-report statement only
thinking.statement: New runs set no thinking override in the frozen plan or harness code. The study's run notes report that the bundled Claude CLI adds adaptive thinking at high effort on the Claude Agent SDK arm; request records were not independently checked. Other runs: not recorded.

harness_version.basis: hashed SDK identity record per slot: 3,982 of 3,982 new native and 1,199 of 1,200 inherited SDK slots match the pinned version constants read in 7 of 7 stage sources; 1 inherited slot without identity and 418 historical and offline-derived slots not recorded
harness_version.statement: New native runs: the pinned version constants in the seven stage sources, confirmed by each receipt's hashed SDK identity record (3,982 of 3,982). Inherited SDK runs: identity records match the same versions for 1,199 of 1,200 (one failed before an identity was written). Historical and offline-derived runs: not recorded.

route.basis: hashed SDK identity requested model for 3,781 slots (3,182 new native, 599 inherited Claude Agent SDK), equal to the report current_route_model; report-recorded current_route_model (equal to the frozen plan route) for 800 new DeepSeek Harness slots; 1,019 slots not recorded
route.statement: Receipt-verified: hashed SDK identity records give the requested route, equal to the report's current route model, for 3,182 new native runs and 599 inherited Claude Agent SDK runs. Report-recorded: the 800 new DeepSeek Harness runs use the report's current route model because their identity records no model. Inherited DeepSeek Harness, historical and offline-derived runs: not recorded.

run_date.basis: UTC date of the receipt started_at timestamp for 5,182 of 5,600 slots (receipt sha256 matched; no slot finished on a later UTC date than it started); 418 slots without a receipt are not recorded
run_date.statement: UTC date of each receipt's recorded start time, for the 5,182 runs with a receipt (none finished on a later UTC date); historical and offline-derived runs: not recorded.

acceptance.basis: visualization README and data.json, daily report and handoff statements; receipts not accessible
acceptance.statement: Stated in the server visualization README and data.json and in the study's daily report and handoff; the underlying receipts were not accessible to this audit.
